definitions.gloss: curriculum; course of study; academic program
definitions.explanation: The organized plan of subjects and content that students follow at a school or university. Defines what is taught, in what order, and how much time is allocated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}される→導入する：16055_dounyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: A new curriculum will be introduced starting next academic year.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実践的|じっせんてき}→実践的：05690_jissenteki⟧な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This university's curriculum has a lot of practical content.

examples.japanese: {教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧、⟦プログラミング→プログラミング：06099_puroguramingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}→必修科目：09286_hisshuukamoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{加|くわ}わった→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: With the revision of the curriculum, programming was added as a required subject.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{教科|きょうか}→教科：09998_kyouka⟧ (school subject) and ⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ (course, program). An educational administration term used in discussions about what schools teach and how education is structured.

USAGE:
More commonly seen as ⟦{教育課程|きょういくかてい}→教育課程：23560_kyouikukatei⟧ (education curriculum) in official documents. {教科課程|きょうかかてい} emphasizes the subject-based structure of the curriculum. Both terms appear in discussions about education reform, school management, and academic planning. The English loanword ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧ is also widely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}する→編成する：22370_henseisuru⟧: to organize a curriculum
- {教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改定|かいてい}→改定：13036_kaitei⟧: curriculum revision
- {教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to be included in the curriculum
- {教科課程|きょうかかてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修了|しゅうりょう}→修了：11655_shuuryou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to complete a course of study

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{教育課程|きょういくかてい}→教育課程：23560_kyouikukatei⟧: education curriculum — the broader, more official term used in government guidelines
- ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧: curriculum — the English loanword, commonly used in both formal and informal contexts
- ⟦{学習指導要領|がくしゅうしどうようりょう}→学習指導要領：26215_gakushuushidouyouryou⟧: Course of Study — the official national curriculum guidelines issued by Japan's Ministry of Education
- ⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧: subject, course — an individual class within the curriculum
